messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 3750001234 - SLO breach detected: inference.latency.p99 = 2700ms (>2000ms threshold). Streaming tail errors +12%. Auto-signal created.
Elaine: paging oncall — @Matt are you up? EU users reporting stalls.
Matt: oncall here, grabbing dashboards.
Matt: quick snapshot — global p95=480ms, p99=2700ms. EU region p99=3100ms, US p99=1800ms. Streaming stalls concentrated on shard-08 and shard-09.
Sophie: looks like KV cache eviction spike on shard-08: eviction_rate ~420/s, cache_hit_rate down 18% last 10m. Prefill queue depth up, decode worker CPU pegged.
Ryan: digging logs, seeing a lot of small hot-key churn after yesterday's model quantization rollout. KV segments very fragmented; allocator churn -> GC-like pauses in cache agent.
Matt: hypothesis: cache fragmentation + prefill/ decode imbalance (prefill backlog, decode workers saturated) => tail latency. Any evidence of IO or network flakiness?
Sophie: no network anomalies, infra stable. Disk iops nominal. CPU pressure on decode pods only.
Matt: ok. Mitigation plan: 1) increase prefill concurrency for shard-08, 2) flip adaptive-eviction to aggressive on that shard, 3) steer new EU traffic to fallback model variant with smaller KV footprint, 4) notify affected customers. Executing step 1 now.
Matt: /runbook increase-prefill --shard=shard-08 --concurrency=8  // kicked off via playbook
PagerDutyBot: Playbook started by Matt (oncall). ETA for change propagation ~30s.
Sophie: patching kv-agent config on shard-08: set `adaptive_eviction=aggressive` and `max_prefill_workers=10`. Applying via rolling restart (1 pod at a time).
Ryan: adding temporary pin for top hot keys to reduce fragmentation: `kvctl pin --shard shard-08 --keys-file /tmp/hotkeys.txt`
Elaine: routing change to reduce pressure: POST to router to route 25% EU traffic to `redwood-lite-v2` (lower mem per-request). Command: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://router.internal/v1/route" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"region":"eu","percent":25,"target":"redwood-lite-v2"}'
```
support-ops: Customer Julia (AcmeCorp) ticket noted slow responses since 10:12 UTC. Affects ~2% of their requests; observed user-facing latencies >5s. Julia asked for ETA on mitigation.
Matt: sending update to AcmeCorp: "we're mitigating increased tail latency in EU; routing and cache fixes underway; expected impact reduction within 5-10 minutes."
Sophie: rolling restart done on 3/4 decode pods, prefill worker counts increased. Eviction rate trending down to 180/s.
Matt: metrics update: shard-08 p99 down from 3100ms -> 1500ms in last 7m. Global p99 now 1600ms. Streaming stalls decreased.
Ryan: noticed a decode path priority inversion: prefill tasks were deprioritized vs decode for the same key leading to starvation. Patch queued: give prefill higher scheduling weight.
Elaine: customer ops confirmation: AcmeCorp acknowledged routing note, says they're seeing improvement on their side.
support-ops: marking ticket as "mitigating" and adding note about steps taken.
Matt: next: short-term mitigation succeeded. For long-term: 1) defragmentation job for KV segments, 2) adjust prefill/ decode scheduler heuristics, 3) run chaos test for eviction spikes, 4) better rollout gating for quantized models. Assign owners?
Sophie: I'll take defragmentation job and eviction telemetry improvements.
Ryan: I'll own scheduler heuristics and the small-priority fix.
Elaine: I'll own rollout gating changes and update the release checklist.
PagerDutyBot: Incident annotated as "mitigated" by Matt at 3750001320. Follow-up doc required.
Matt: closing on-call handoff notes: incident origin = KV cache fragmentation after quantized model rollout -> prefill vs decode imbalance -> eviction surge -> streaming tail latency. Mitigation: increased prefill concurrency, aggressive eviction, traffic steering, pinned hot keys. Outcome: p99 reduced below SLO.
Customer-Julia: Thanks for the quick response team — saw big improvement within minutes. Appreciate the updates. :thumbsup:
Matt: thanks all. We'll create a postmortem with timeline, graphs, and concrete rollout gating steps. Leaving follow-up ticket in #eng-sre. :white_check_mark:
